evals.prompt: Create a generic soft low-poly clay still with an abstract multipart model, several props and a floor. Use CPU Cycles and a reusable style profile; preserve the existing startup scene. Rerun without duplicate resources.
evals.expected_output: Editable project recipe and profile, clay node palette, soft area-light rig, rendered still, read-only QA and stable counts across reruns.

evals.prompt: Apply the same clay tooling to a different Blender project with a new two-color palette, twice the reference scale and portrait EEVEE output. Keep the project independent of any action library.
evals.expected_output: Independent scene-scoped materials/world/camera/lights, quadratic light-power scaling, portrait framing, no A.blend or project-specific runtime dependency.
assertions: Power scales with reference length squared

evals.prompt: Make a 24fps clay preview loop with 12 pose updates per second. Preserve a shared source Action, exclude the duplicate endpoint from delivery, render a PNG sequence and H.264 preview, and reject conflicting artistic modifiers before editing.
evals.expected_output: Source Action retained, separate owned action with two-frame hold, evaluated loop QA, 24 ordered image frames and a 1-second 24fps video.
assertions: Pose holds and loop endpoint pass
Video decoder confirms frame count and FPS
